short: Total local gain after costs and losses

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.SizeData₂.sg
lean.plain: Total local gain after costs and losses
lean.note: The real number $g(u,\lambda)$ adds the gains from the individual lifts, adds their first corrections, and subtracts their word-dependent corrections. Multiplication by the ramification index and rounding down turn this sum into the local valuation threshold.
